historical_interpretation: Retrospective held-out-result blind replay. The candidate-space hypothesis was formalized after the current follow-up experiment was known, but the evaluated model is blinded to the follow-up formulation/outcome and scoring labels. Future rounds can become prospective after this V2 configuration is frozen.
blindness_definition: The evaluated Agent may use original local evidence, the V2 evidence-derived hypothesis, uncertainty-aware actions, and external database/literature evidence. It may not see the current follow-up formulation, follow-up thermal-hold measurements, adjudication labels, or controller-side scoring targets.

controller_only_heldout_target.scoring_space: two-dimensional modifier plane: acrylic-like pct and tackifier-like pct

ranking_contract.rank_2_plus: alternatives_considered in strict descending preference order
ranking_contract.top_3: selected_candidate_id followed by the first two unique valid alternatives
ranking_contract.abstention_shortlist_diagnostic: For abstentions, alternatives may be analyzed separately as an uncertainty shortlist but do not count toward primary Top-1 or Top-3 recovery.

run_protocol.seed_policy: record_if_endpoint_supports_seed; otherwise record run_index and treat calls as repeated stochastic realizations

secondary_region_metrics.note: This controller-side threshold is used only after outputs are frozen and is not exposed to the Agent. Distance scoring is preferred over an exact 18% scalar target because V2 uses independent acrylic/tackifier axes.

baselines.description: Deterministic ranking from the same allowed evidence/actions without free-form LLM reasoning.
Rank candidates by class-specific distance to independent acrylic/tackifier evidence anchors, without local rheology.

interpretation_rules: V2 tests whether an evidence-using Agent can prioritize a literature-supported region that is compositionally close to the held-out experiment, not whether it reproduces the exact follow-up recipe.
Because the V2 hypothesis was formalized after the current follow-up result was known, current results are retrospective blind replay evidence, not prospective validation of V2 itself.
After V2 is frozen, the same workflow can be used prospectively for future rounds.

If deterministic evidence ranking already places the nearest candidate first, the Agent contribution must be evaluated through evidence integration, uncertainty handling, robustness, abstention, and alternative ranking rather than discovery alone.
Primary Top-3 recovery is defined only for valid non-abstaining recommendations; abstention shortlists are reported separately and never credited as successful primary recovery.
